<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Serial-to-Parallel Conversion Circuit</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="RECEIVE">Receiving state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT">Outputting state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter to keep track of the number of received serial input data bits.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data register.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_valid">Valid output signal register.</reg>
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of clk
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                dout_parallel <= 8'd0;
                dout_valid <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case ({din_valid, cnt})
                    {1'b1, 4'd0}: begin
                        dout_parallel[7] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    {1'b1, 4'd1}: begin
                        dout_parallel[6] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    {1'b1, 4'd2}: begin
                        dout_parallel[5] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    {1'b1, 4'd3}: begin
                        dout_parallel[4] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    {1'b1, 4'd4}: begin
                        dout_parallel[3] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    {1'b1, 4'd5}: begin
                        dout_parallel[2] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    {1'b1, 4'd6}: begin
                        dout_parallel[1] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    {1'b1, 4'd7}: begin
                        dout_parallel[0] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                        dout_valid <= 1'b0;
                    end
                endcase
                
                // Set dout_valid to 1 when cnt reaches 8
                if (cnt == 4'd8) begin
                    dout_valid <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    dout_valid <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
</module>
